Run after 3.1. Volcano and protein UpSet plots use saved results and thresholds; no model is refitted.

```{r setup}
source("CoPPRA_config.R", local = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ComplexUpset)
```


# Read saved limma results



```{r read_limma}
paths <- stage_paths("Limma")
plot_folder <- paths$plots
list2env(readRDS(file.path(paths$data, "Limma_results.rds")), envir = environment())
```

# Peptide volcano plots



```{r peptide_volcano, fig.width=13, fig.height=4.5}
volcano_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  peptide_significance %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Sequence,
      log2FC = Ru_log2FC,
      p_value = Ru_vs_Control_pvalue,
      Comparison = "R vs Control"
    ),
  peptide_significance %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Sequence,
      log2FC = Ul_log2FC,
      p_value = Ul_vs_Control_pvalue,
      Comparison = "U vs Control"
    ),
  peptide_significance %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Sequence,
      log2FC = RU_log2FC,
      p_value = RU_vs_Control_pvalue,
      Comparison = "RU vs Control"
    ),
  peptide_significance %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Sequence,
      log2FC = RU_vs_R_log2FC,
      p_value = RU_vs_R_pvalue,
      Comparison = "RU vs R"
    ),
  peptide_significance %>%
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Sequence,
      log2FC = RU_vs_U_log2FC,
      p_value = RU_vs_U_pvalue,
      Comparison = "RU vs U"
    )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Comparison = factor(
      Comparison,
      levels = c("R vs Control", "U vs Control", "RU vs Control", "RU vs R", "RU vs U")
    ),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(
      pmax(p_value, .Machine$double.xmin)
    ),
    Peptide_call = dplyr::case_when(
      p_value < pval_threshold &
        log2FC > log2fc_threshold ~ "Higher in first group",
      p_value < pval_threshold &
        log2FC < -log2fc_threshold ~ "Higher in second group",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(log2FC), is.finite(p_value))

p_volcano <- ggplot(
  volcano_data,
  aes(log2FC, neg_log10_p, color = Peptide_call)
) +
  geom_point(size = 1.4, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(pval_threshold),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-log2fc_threshold, log2fc_threshold),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Comparison, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Not significant" = "grey75",
      "Higher in second group" = "#1F77B4",
      "Higher in first group" = "#D62728"
    ),
    name = "Peptide call"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "log2(Fold Change)",
    y = "-log10(P value)"
  ) +
  # Match Figure 2A typography: titles 18, axes 14/13, legend 14/13 pt.
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

print(p_volcano)

save_plot(p_volcano, "peptide_volcano_five_comparisons", 13, 4.5, dpi = 600)
```

# Protein intersections



```{r protein_upset, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.5}
if (nrow(protein_significance) == 0L) {
  cat("No significant proteins; no UpSet intersections to draw.\n")
} else {
protein_upset_data <- protein_significance %>%
  dplyr::select(ProteinID, Ru_sig, RU_sig, Ul_sig)

colnames(protein_upset_data) <- c("ProteinID", "R", "RU", "U")

# Figure 2B uses the same condition colors, shapes, and text sizes as PCA.
# Discrete y limits run bottom to top, hence rev() below; disable set-size sorting.
upset_condition_order <- c("RU", "R", "U")
upset_condition_shapes <- c(RU = 18, R = 17, U = 15)
upset_theme <- theme(
  text = element_text(size = 13),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
  legend.position = "right"
)
# Build fresh themes: ComplexUpset 1.3.3's stored themes predate ggplot2 4.
upset_base_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) + upset_theme
upset_panel_themes <- list(
  default = upset_base_theme,
  intersections_matrix = upset_base_theme + theme(panel.grid = element_blank()),
  overall_sizes = upset_base_theme + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()),
  `Intersection size` = upset_base_theme
)
upset_matrix <- intersection_matrix(
  geom = geom_point(aes(shape = group), size = 3.5),
  segment = geom_segment(color = "black"),
  outline_color = list(active = "transparent", inactive = "transparent")
) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = upset_condition_shapes, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = "grey85"), guide = "none")
upset_condition_queries <- lapply(upset_condition_order, function(condition) {
  upset_query(
    set = condition,
    color = unname(condition_colors[condition]),
    only_components = "intersections_matrix"
  )
})

p_upset <- upset(
  protein_upset_data,
  rev(upset_condition_order),
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  name = "Significant proteins",
  encode_sets = FALSE,
  matrix = upset_matrix,
  queries = upset_condition_queries,
  base_annotations = list(
    "Protein Numbers" = intersection_size(
      text = list(size = 13 / ggplot2::.pt)
    ) +
      labs(y = "Protein Numbers") +
      upset_theme
  ),
  set_sizes = upset_set_size() +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 2)),
  width_ratio = 0.18,
  height_ratio = 0.40,
  min_size = 1,
  themes = upset_panel_themes
)

print(p_upset)

save_plot(p_upset, "significant_protein_upset", 9, 4.5)
}
```
